meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 编辑类工具(apply_patch、write、edit 等)调用成功后,插件会通过 PostToolUse 钩子运行 comment-checker。发现注释问题时,Codex 会收到阻塞性反馈,需先修正或解释被标记的注释再继续。插件不对外暴露 MCP 工具。
howto.when: 当 Codex 在编辑类工具调用成功后收到 comment-checker 的警告反馈时触发,需要理解或回应这类反馈。非编辑类工具被该插件忽略。

say.text: 刚收到的 comment-checker 警告是什么原因?
say.note: 它会说明被标记的注释

say.text: 把 comment-checker 标记的注释改掉。
解释这条注释为什么被警告,先别改代码。

howto.what_en: After successful edit-like calls (apply_patch, write, edit), a PostToolUse hook runs comment-checker. If it warns about comments, Codex gets blocking feedback and should fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing. No MCP tool is exposed.
howto.when_en: When Codex receives comment-checker warning feedback after a successful edit-like tool call, or needs to understand and respond to it. Non-edit tools are ignored.

say_en.text: What caused the comment-checker warning I just got?
Explain the flagged comment without editing code.
say_en.note: You get an explanation, no edits
